_notes.featureTypes: passive=just text shown, proficiency_choice=pick N skills from list, expertise_choice=pick N skills for expertise, choice=pick one option from named list, language_choice=pick N extra languages, asi_points=spend N points on abilities (stackable)
_notes.languages: autoLanguages = languages the species always knows (shown as granted, not re-selectable). language_choice features let them pick additional ones.
_notes.abilityBonusChoices: Use asi_points type feature instead of the old abilityBonusChoices field. Set 'points' to total points to spend, 'exclude' to ability keys that can't receive points.
_notes.subclasses: Each class can have a 'subclasses' object. Key = subclass name, value = object with 'features' array (same format).

features.name: Extra Language

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

features.name: Elf Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

features.name: High Elf Cantrip
features.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Extra Language

features.name: Elf Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

features.name: Fleet of Foot
features.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

features.name: Mask of the Wild
features.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

features.name: Superior Darkvision
features.description: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet.

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

features.name: Drow Magic
features.description: You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level you can cast Faerie Fire once per long rest. At 5th level you can cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

features.name: Drow Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

features.name: Fey Step
features.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest. When you reach 3rd level, your Fey Step gains an additional effect based on the season: Spring (charm creature at destination), Summer (deal fire damage to creatures within 5 ft), Autumn (frighten creatures within 5 ft), Winter (impose disadvantage on attack rolls against you until start of next turn).

features.name: Elf Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

source.book: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

features.name: Child of the Sea
features.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet, and you can breathe air and water.

features.name: Friend of the Sea
features.description: Using gestures and sounds, you can communicate simple ideas with any beast that has a swimming speed.

features.name: Sea Elf Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with the spear, trident, light crossbow, and net.

source.book: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

features.name: Necrotic Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

features.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
features.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You then have resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

source.book: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

features.name: Dwarven Resilience

features.name: Dwarven Combat Training

features.name: Tool Proficiency

features.name: Stonecunning

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

features.name: Dwarven Armor Training
features.description: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.description: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

features.name: Stout Resilience

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

features.name: Natural Illusionist
features.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Speak with Small Beasts
features.description: Through sounds and gestures, you can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

features.name: Artificer's Lore
features.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Tinker
features.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). Using these tools you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device.

Half-Elf.description: Half-elves combine the curiosity, inventiveness, and ambition of their human heritage with the refined senses, love of nature, and artistic tastes of their elven heritage.

Standard Half-Elf.name: Standard Half-Elf
Standard Half-Elf.description: The most common half-elves, born of human and elf unions throughout the world.

Aquatic Half-Elf.name: Aquatic Half-Elf
Aquatic Half-Elf.description: Some half-elves near the sea carry the legacy of sea elf blood.

features.name: Swim Speed
features.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

Drow Half-Elf.name: Drow Half-Elf
Drow Half-Elf.description: Drawing on a drow parent's heritage, some half-elves have particularly strong ties to the Underdark.

features.name: Drow Magic
features.description: You know the Dancing Lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast Faerie Fire once and need to finish a long rest before you can cast it again. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast Darkness once and need to finish a long rest before you can do so again. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

High Elf Half-Elf.name: High Elf Half-Elf
High Elf Half-Elf.description: Some half-elves with high elf blood have an innate gift for magic.

features.name: Cantrip
features.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

Wood Elf Half-Elf.name: Wood Elf Half-Elf
Wood Elf Half-Elf.description: Half-elves with wood elf blood are fleet of foot and stealthy.

features.name: Menacing
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Thanks to your infernal heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

features.name: Hellish Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Infernal Legacy
features.description: Thaumaturgy cantrip; Hellish Rebuke (2nd level) 1/long rest at 3rd; Darkness 1/long rest at 5th. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Legacy of Avernus
features.description: Same as standard Infernal Legacy. Patron of Tieflings who trace their descent to Asmodeus.

features.name: Legacy of Avernus (Zariel)
features.description: Thaumaturgy cantrip; Searing Smite 1/long rest at 3rd; Branding Smite 1/long rest at 5th. CHA is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Legacy of Dis
features.description: Thaumaturgy cantrip; Disguise Self 1/long rest at 3rd; Detect Thoughts 1/long rest at 5th.

features.name: Legacy of Malbolge
features.description: Minor Illusion cantrip; Disguise Self 1/long rest at 3rd; Invisibility 1/long rest at 5th.

features.name: Legacy of Stygia
features.description: Ray of Frost cantrip; Armor of Agathys 1/long rest at 3rd; Darkness 1/long rest at 5th.

features.name: Legacy of Minauros
features.description: Mage Hand cantrip; Tenser's Floating Disk 1/long rest at 3rd; Arcane Lock 1/long rest at 5th.

features.name: Legacy of Cania
features.description: Mage Hand cantrip; Burning Hands 1/long rest at 3rd; Flame Blade 1/long rest at 5th.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.description: You have draconic ancestry of a particular type of dragon. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. This determines your breath weapon and damage resistance.
options: Black — Acid (5 by 30 ft. line, Dex save)
Blue — Lightning (5 by 30 ft. line, Dex save)
Brass — Fire (5 by 30 ft. line, Dex save)
Bronze — Lightning (5 by 30 ft. line, Dex save)
Copper — Acid (5 by 30 ft. line, Dex save)
Gold — Fire (15 ft. cone, Dex save)
Green — Poison (15 ft. cone, Con save)
Red — Fire (15 ft. cone, Dex save)
Silver — Cold (15 ft. cone, Con save)
White — Cold (15 ft. cone, Con save)

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Your draconic ancestry determines the size, shape, and damage type of the exhalation. When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a saving throw, the type of which is determined by your draconic ancestry. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes 2d6 damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level. After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.
features.note: Exhale energy in a cone or line; DEX save for half damage

features.name: Damage Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Blessed with a radiant soul, your vision can easily cut through darkness. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Celestial Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

features.name: Healing Hands
features.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and cause it to regain hit points equal to your level. Once per long rest.
features.note: Touch a creature; restore HP equal to your level

features.name: Light Bearer
features.description: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Celestial Revelation
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you can unleash the celestial energy within yourself. Choose one of the following forms. Once per day you can use your transformation as a bonus action, lasting for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. During it, other creatures within 10 feet of you that fail a Charisma saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier) become frightened of you until the end of your next turn (Necrotic Shroud only). You regain the ability to use this after a long rest.

invocations.name: Necrotic Shroud
invocations.description: Your eyes turn into empty black voids, shadowy wings sprout from your back, and necrotic energy radiates from you. Enemies within 10 ft who fail a Charisma save are frightened until end of your next turn. Once per turn when you deal damage, you can deal extra necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

invocations.name: Radiant Consumption
invocations.description: Searing light temporarily radiates from your eyes and mouth. For the duration, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Once per turn when you deal damage, you can deal extra radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

invocations.name: Radiant Soul
invocations.description: Two luminous, incorporeal wings sprout from your back. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Once per turn when you deal damage, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target equal to your proficiency bonus.

Aasimar.description: Aasimar are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls. They can innately access this power to heal others, sear foes, and manifest luminous wings.

Dhampir.description: Dhampirs are mortals who walk the line between life and undeath. Born of a vampire's curse or dark ritual, they carry the hunger of the undead within them while retaining the warmth of the living. They are neither fully vampire nor fully mortal, existing in an unsettling twilight between two worlds.

features.name: Ability Score Increases
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2 and another by 1, or increase three different ability scores by 1 each.

features.name: Size
features.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

features.name: Ancestral Legacy
features.description: If you replace a race with this lineage, you can keep skill proficiencies and any climbing, flying, or swimming speed from that race. Select your ancestral race below to inherit its skill proficiencies, or choose two skill proficiencies of your own if you prefer a standalone Dhampir.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

features.name: Deathless Nature
features.description: You don't need to breathe. You also have resistance to necrotic damage.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: You have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed. In addition, at 3rd level, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

features.name: Vampiric Bite
features.description: Your fanged bite is a natural weapon (simple melee, proficient). Attack roll uses Constitution modifier instead of Strength. Deals 1d4 piercing damage. While missing half or more HP, you have advantage on this attack. On a hit vs a non-Construct/Undead, choose one: regain HP equal to damage dealt, or gain a bonus to your next attack roll or ability check equal to damage dealt. Uses per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for your character.

features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d12 per Barbarian level. HP at 1st level: 12 + Constitution modifier. HP at higher levels: 1d12 (or 7) + Constitution modifier per level above 1st.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Armor: Light, Medium, Shields. Weapons: Simple, Martial. Saving Throws: Strength, Constitution. Skills: Choose 2 from Animal Handling, Athletics, Intimidation, Nature, Perception, Survival.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 2 skills from the Barbarian list.

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging, you gain the following benefits if you aren't wearing heavy armor: Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. When you make a melee weapon attack using Strength, you gain a bonus to the damage roll that increases as you gain levels as a barbarian: +2 at levels 1–8, +3 at levels 9–15, +4 at levels 16–20. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Rage lasts 1 minute. It ends early if you are knocked unconscious or if your turn ends and you haven't attacked a hostile creature or taken damage since your last turn. You can also end your rage on your turn as a bonus action. Rages per long rest: 2 at level 1, 3 at level 3, 4 at level 6, 5 at level 12, 6 at level 17, unlimited at level 20.
features.note: Advantage on STR checks/saves, resistance to B/P/S damage

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are not wearing any armor, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly, giving you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.
features.note: Advantage on STR attacks this turn; attacks against you have advantage

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: At 2nd level, you gain an uncanny sense of when things nearby aren't as they should be, giving you an edge when you dodge away from danger. You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: At 3rd level, you choose a path that shapes the nature of your rage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. You can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.
features.note: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Starting at 5th level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: By 7th level, your instincts are so honed that you have advantage on initiative rolls. Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren't incapacitated, you can act normally on your first turn, but only if you enter your rage before doing anything else on that turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Brutal Critical
features.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a melee attack. This increases to two additional dice at 13th level and three additional dice at 17th level.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you're raging and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Brutal Critical (2 dice)
features.description: At 13th level, you roll two additional weapon damage dice on a critical hit with a melee attack (upgrade from Brutal Critical at level 9).

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, your rage is so fierce that it ends early only if you fall unconscious or if you choose to end it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Brutal Critical (3 dice)
features.description: At 17th level, you roll three additional weapon damage dice on a critical hit with a melee attack (upgrade from Brutal Critical at levels 9 and 13).

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, if your total for a Strength check is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: At 20th level, you embody the power of the wilds. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4. Your maximum for those scores is now 24.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.description: Yours is a path that seeks attunement with the natural world, giving you a kinship with beasts. At 3rd level you gain the ability to cast the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells as rituals.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: At 3rd level, when you adopt this path, you choose a totem spirit and gain its feature. Bear: While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic. Eagle: While raging, other creatures have disadvantage on opportunity attack rolls against you, and you can use the Dash action as a bonus action. Wolf: While raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to them.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: At 6th level, you gain a magical benefit based on the totem animal of your choice. Bear: Your carrying capacity (including maximum load and maximum lift) is doubled, and you have advantage on Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects. Eagle: You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, and dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks. Wolf: You can track other creatures while traveling at a fast pace, and you can move stealthily while traveling at a normal pace.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.description: At 14th level, you gain a magical benefit based on a totem animal of your choice. Bear: While raging, any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature. Eagle: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed. Wolf: While raging, you can use a bonus action on your turn to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with melee weapon attack.

Path of the Ancestral Guardian.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
Path of the Ancestral Guardian.description: Some barbarians hail from cultures that revere their ancestors. These barbarians summon the spirits of their ancestors to protect their allies.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, while you're raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on your turn becomes the target of the warriors who fell before you. Until the start of your next turn, that target has disadvantage on any attack roll that isn't against you, and when the target hits a creature other than you with an attack, that creature has resistance to the damage dealt by the attack. The effect ends early if your rage ends.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, the guardian spirits that aid you can provide supernatural protection to those you defend. If you are raging and another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6. When you reach certain levels in this class, you can reduce the damage by more: 3d6 at 10th level and 4d6 at 14th level.

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: At 10th level, you gain the ability to consult with your ancestral spirits. When you do so, you cast the augury or clairvoyance spell, without using a spell slot or material components. Rather than creating a spherical sensor, this use of clairvoyance invisibly summons one of your ancestral spirits to the chosen location. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells. After you cast either spell in this way, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: At 14th level, your ancestral spirits grow powerful enough to retaliate. When you use your Spirit Shield to reduce the damage of an attack, the attacker takes an amount of force damage equal to the damage that your Spirit Shield prevents.

Path of the Storm Herald.name: Path of the Storm Herald
Path of the Storm Herald.description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the Storm Herald learn to transform their rage into a mantle of primal magic that swirls around them.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: You emanate a stormy, magical aura while you rage. Choose your environment: Desert: When activated, all creatures in a 10-foot radius take 2 fire damage (increases to 3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th level). Sea: When activated, choose one creature you can see in a 10-foot radius. It must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 lightning damage and be pushed up to 10 feet away (damage increases as you level). Tundra: When activated, each creature of your choice in a 10-foot radius gains 2 temporary hit points (increases at higher levels). Each affected creature can't gain temporary hit points from this feature again until they finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: At 6th level, the storm grants you benefits even when your aura isn't active. Desert: You gain resistance to fire damage and don't suffer exhaustion from extreme heat. Sea: You gain resistance to lightning damage and can breathe underwater. You gain a swimming speed of 30 feet. Tundra: You gain resistance to cold damage and don't suffer exhaustion from extreme cold.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: At 10th level, you learn to use your mastery of the storm to protect others. Each creature of your choice has the damage resistance your Storm Soul feature grants while the creature is within 10 feet of you and you are raging.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description: At 14th level, the power of the storm you channel grows mightier, lashing out at your foes. Desert: Immediately after a creature in your aura hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + Con modifier + proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature takes fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: When you hit a creature in your aura with an attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + Con modifier + proficiency bonus). On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone. Tundra: Whenever the effect of your Storm Aura is activated, you can choose one creature you can see in the aura. That creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + Con modifier + proficiency bonus) or its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

Path of the Zealot.name: Path of the Zealot
Path of the Zealot.description: Some deities inspire their followers to pitch themselves into a ferocious battle fury. These barbarians are zealots — warriors who channel their rage into powerful displays of divine power.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can channel divine fury into your weapon strikes. While you're raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a weapon attack takes extra damage equal to 1d6 + half your barbarian level. The extra damage is necrotic or radiant; you choose the type of damage when you gain this feature.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: At 3rd level, your soul is marked for endless battle. If a spell, such as raise dead, has the sole effect of restoring you to life (but not undeath), the caster doesn't need material components to cast the spell on you.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Starting at 6th level, the divine power that fuels your rage can protect you. If you fail a saving throw while you're raging, you can reroll it, and you must use the new roll. You can use this ability only once per rage.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: At 10th level, you learn to channel divine power to inspire zealotry in others. As a bonus action, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can hear you gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Rage Beyond Death
features.description: Beginning at 14th level, the divine power that fuels your rage allows you to shrug off fatal blows. While you're raging, having 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious. You still must make death saving throws, and you suffer the normal effects of taking damage while at 0 hit points. However, if you would die due to failing death saving throws, you don't die until your rage ends, and you die then only if you still have 0 hit points.

Path of the Beast.name: Path of the Beast
Path of the Beast.description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Beast draw their rage from a bestial spark burning within their souls. That beast bursts forth in the throes of rage.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, when you enter your rage, you can transform, revealing the bestial power within you. Until the rage ends, you manifest a natural weapon. Choose one of: Bite: Your mouth transforms into a bestial maw. It deals 1d8 piercing damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you damage a creature with this bite, you regain a number of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus, provided you have fewer than half your hit points when you hit. Claws: Each of your hands transforms into a claw, which you can use as a weapon. It deals 1d6 slashing damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you attack with a claw, you can make one additional claw attack as part of the same action. Tail: You grow a lashing, spiny tail, which deals 1d8 piercing damage on a hit. When you are hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to swipe your tail and roll a d8, adding the number rolled to your AC for that attack.

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, the feral power within you increases, causing the natural weapons of your Form of the Beast to count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. You can also alter your form to help you adapt to your surroundings. When you finish a long rest, choose one of the following benefits, which lasts until your next long rest: swimming speed equal to your walking speed and can breathe underwater; climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can climb difficult surfaces; or after you jump, you can extend your legs to slow your fall to 10 feet per round.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.description: At 10th level, when you hit a creature with your natural weapons while raging, the beast within you can curse your target with rabid fury. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or suffer one of the following effects (your choice): The target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice that you can see. The target takes 2d12 psychic damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.description: At 14th level, the beast within you grows so powerful that you can spread its ferocity to others. When you enter your rage, you can choose a number of other willing creatures you can see within 30 feet of you equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one creature). Until the rage ends, each creature can use the following benefit once on each of their turns: When the creature hits a target with an attack roll and deals damage to it, the creature can roll a d6 and gain temporary hit points equal to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Path of Wild Magic.name: Path of Wild Magic
Path of Wild Magic.description: Many places in the multiverse abound with beauty, intense emotion, and rampant magic; the Feywild, the Upper Planes, and other realms of supernatural power radiate with such forces and can profoundly affect people.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.description: As an action, you can open your awareness to the presence of concentrated magic. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any spell or magic item within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover. When you sense a spell, you know which school of magic it belongs to. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, the magic that suffuses you causes unpredictable surges. Whenever you enter your rage, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (d8) to determine the magical effect produced. Effects include: creating a barrier of magical force, shooting bolts of force at enemies, becoming surrounded by multicolored light, teleporting, creating a spectral warrior, summoning energy, gaining temporary HP, or making yourself nearly invisible to enemies. If a surge creates a lasting effect, it lasts until the rage ends unless specified otherwise.

features.name: Bolstering Magic
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can harness your wild magic to bolster yourself or a companion. As an action, you can touch one creature (which can be yourself) and confer one of the following benefits of your choice to that creature: For 10 minutes, the creature can roll a d3 whenever it makes an attack roll or an ability check and add the number rolled to the d20 roll. Roll a d3. The creature regains one expended spell slot of a level equal to or less than the number rolled, and the creature must be a spellcaster with spell slots. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.description: At 10th level, when you are imperiled during your rage, the magic within you can lash out; immediately after you take damage or fail a saving throw while raging, you can use your reaction to roll on the Wild Magic table and immediately produce the effect rolled. This effect replaces your current Wild Magic effect.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.description: At 14th level, whenever you roll on the Wild Magic table, you can roll the die twice and choose which of the two effects to apply. If you roll the same number on both dice, you can ignore the number and choose any effect on the table.

fixed.name: Explorer's Pack
fixed.description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days rations, waterskin, 50ft hempen rope

features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d8 per Rogue level. HP at 1st level: 8 + Constitution modifier. HP at higher levels: 1d8 (or 5) + Constitution modifier per level above 1st.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Armor: Light. Weapons: Simple, Hand Crossbows, Longswords, Rapiers, Shortswords. Tools: Thieves' Tools. Saving Throws: Dexterity, Intelligence.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 4 skills from the Rogue list.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: At 1st level, choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of your skill proficiencies and your proficiency with thieves' tools. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Beginning at 1st level, you know how to strike subtly and exploit a foe's distraction. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. This extra damage increases as you gain Rogue levels: 2d6 at 3rd, 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 7th, 5d6 at 9th...
features.note: Once per turn on attack with advantage or with ally adjacent to target

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: During your rogue training you learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation. It takes four times longer to convey such a message than it does to speak the same idea plainly.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act quickly. You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat. This action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
features.note: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you emulate in the exercise of your rogue abilities.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You can't exceed 20.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Starting at 5th level, when an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.
features.note: Halve damage from one attack you can see

features.name: Expertise (2nd)
features.description: At 6th level, choose two more of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for those skills.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, you can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain area effects. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: By 11th level, you have refined your chosen skills until they approach perfection. Whenever you make an ability check that lets you add your proficiency bonus, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Blindsense
features.description: Starting at 14th level, if you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: By 15th level, you have acquired greater mental strength. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: At 20th level, you have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. If your attack misses a target within range, you can turn the miss into a hit. Alternatively, if you fail an ability check, you can treat the d20 roll as a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. Additionally, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: By 13th level, you have learned enough about the workings of magic that you can improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: When you reach 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you can unfailingly create false identities for yourself.

features.name: Impostor
features.description: At 13th level, you gain the ability to unerringly mimic another person's speech, writing, and behavior.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: Starting at 17th level, you become a master of instant death. When you attack and hit a creature that is surprised, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, double the damage of your attack against the creature.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast spells. You learn 3 cantrips (Mage Hand plus 2 others from the wizard list) and 3 1st-level spells from the enchantment or illusion schools.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, when you cast Mage Hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible, and you can perform the following additional tasks with it.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: Starting at 9th level, if you are hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, the creature has disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell this turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: At 13th level, you gain the ability to distract targets with your Mage Hand. As a bonus action on your turn, you can designate a creature within 5 feet of the spectral hand created by the spell. Doing so gives you advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of the turn.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: At 17th level, you gain the ability to magically steal the knowledge of how to cast a spell from another spellcaster.

Inquisitive.name: Inquisitive
Inquisitive.description: An archetypal Inquisitive focuses on rooting out secrets and lies. You rely on a sharp eye for detail, but also on a finely honed ability to read the words and deeds of other creatures.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: You develop a talent for picking out lies. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: You can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object or to make an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: You can use a bonus action to make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature you can see that isn't incapacitated, contested by that creature's Charisma (Deception) check. If you succeed, you can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage on it. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: You have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: Your senses are almost impossible to foil. As an action, you sense the presence within 30 feet of you of illusions, shapechangers not in their original form, and other magic designed to deceive the senses, though you can't determine the nature of the deception. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: You learn to exploit a creature's weaknesses by carefully studying it during battle. While your Insightful Fighting feature applies to a creature, your Sneak Attack damage against that creature increases by 3d6.

Mastermind.name: Mastermind
Mastermind.description: Your focus is on people and on the influence and secrets they have. Many spies, courtiers, and schemers follow this archetype, leading lives of intrigue.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice. Additionally, you can unerringly mimic the speech patterns and accent of a creature that you have heard speak for at least 1 minute.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: You can use the Help action as a bonus action. Additionally, when you use the Help action to aid an ally in attacking a creature, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than 5 feet, if the target can see or hear you.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: If you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following: Intelligence score, Wisdom score, Charisma score, or class levels (if any). At the DM's option, you might also realize you know a piece of the creature's history or a secret it holds.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: You can sometimes cause another creature to suffer for your misdeeds. When you are targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet of you is granting you cover against that attack, you can use your reaction to have the attack target that creature instead of you.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Your thoughts can't be determined by telepathy or other means, unless you choose to allow it. You can present false thoughts by making a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates you are being truthful if you so choose, and you can't be compelled to tell the truth by magic.

Scout.name: Scout
Scout.description: You are an expert in navigating the wilderness. You learn to evade both the beastly hunters and the humanoid scouts who frequent the wilds.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: You are difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills if you don't already have it. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. If you have a climbing or swimming speed, this increase applies to that speed as well.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: You excel at leading ambushes and acting first in a fight. You have advantage on initiative rolls. In addition, the first creature you hit during the first round of a combat becomes easier for you and others to strike; attack rolls against that target have advantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: You can strike with deadly speed. If you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack as a bonus action. This attack can benefit from your Sneak Attack even if you have already used it this turn, but you can't use your Sneak Attack twice on the same target.

Swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.description: You focus your training on the art of the blade, relying on speed, elegance, and charm in equal parts. While some warriors are brutes clad in heavy armor, your method of fighting looks almost like a performance.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn how to land a strike and then slip away without reprisal. During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier. You also gain an additional way to use your Sneak Attack; you don't need advantage on the attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Panache
features.description: Your charm becomes extraordinarily beguiling. As an action, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. If you succeed, the creature is charmed by you for 1 minute, or until one of your companions attacks it, or until you attack another creature. While charmed, a hostile creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you, and must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) each time it tries to move more than 30 feet away from you; if it succeeds, this feature doesn't restrict its movement for that turn.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: You can use a bonus action on your turn to gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.description: Your mastery of the blade lets you turn failure into success in combat. If you miss with an attack roll, you can roll it again with advantage. Once you do so, you can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.description: Many rogues walk a fine line between life and death, risking their own lives and taking the lives of others. While adventuring on that line, some rogues discover a mystical connection to death itself.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: Echoes of those who have died cling to you. Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can choose one skill or tool proficiency that you lack and gain it, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this feature again.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.description: As you nudge someone closer to the grave, you can channel the power of death to harm someone else as well. Immediately after you deal your Sneak Attack damage to a creature on your turn, you can target a second creature within 30 feet of the first. Roll half the number of Sneak Attack dice (rounded down), and the second creature takes necrotic damage equal to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.description: When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to magically summon that creature's soul in a tiny object — a token of the departed. The token is a Tiny object and has an AC of 10, 1 hit point, and immunity to psychic and poison damage. You can have a maximum number of tokens equal to your proficiency bonus, and you can use a token in a number of ways.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.description: You can phase partially into the realm of the dead, becoming like a ghost. As a bonus action, you assume a spectral form. While in this form, you have a flying speed of 10 feet, you can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, and you have resistance to all damage. You can remain in this form for up to 10 minutes or until you end it as a bonus action. To use this feature again, you must finish a long rest or expend a Wails from the Grave use.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.description: Your association with death has become so close that you gain the following benefits: When you use your Wails from the Grave, you can deal the necrotic damage to both the first and the second creature. At the end of a long rest, a life force pays you a small visit. Roll any die, and you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the roll plus your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 temporary hit point).

Soulknife.name: Soulknife
Soulknife.description: Most assassins strike with physical weapons, and many burglars and spies use thieves' tools in their trade. In contrast, a Soulknife strikes and infiltrates with the mind, cutting through barriers both physical and psychic.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. It is represented by your Psionic Energy dice, which are d6s. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus, and they fuel various psionic powers you have. When you use a psionic power, some of these dice are expended. You regain all your expended Psionic Energy dice when you finish a long rest, and you regain one when you finish a short rest (minimum 1). Psy-Bolstered Knack, Psychic Whispers.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: You can manifest your psionic power as shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the Attack action, you can manifest a psychic blade from your free hand and make the attack with that blade. This magic blade is a simple melee weapon with finesse and thrown properties (range 60/120 ft.). It deals 1d6 psychic damage on hit, and vanishes after striking or missing. You can't attack with it again until you take the Attack action again. You can manifest a second psychic blade as a bonus action for an off-hand attack.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Your Psychic Blades are now an expression of your psi-suffused soul, granting you these benefits: Homing Strikes — you can add one Psionic Energy die to the damage of your psychic blade attack that missed. Psychic Teleportation — as a bonus action, you manifest a psychic blade, expend one Psionic Energy die, and throw the blade at an unoccupied space up to 30 feet away, teleporting to that space.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: You can weave a veil of psychic static to mask yourself. As an action, you can magically become invisible, along with anything you are wearing or carrying, for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect (no action required). This invisibility ends early immediately after you deal damage to a creature or you force a creature to make a saving throw. You can use this feature once, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest, or when you expend a Psionic Energy die (no action required).

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: You can sweep your Psychic Blades through a creature's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier). If the save fails, the target is stunned until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

options.name: Burglar's Pack
options.description: Backpack, ball bearings, string, bell, candles, crowbar, hammer, pitons, lantern, oil, rations, tinderbox, waterskin, rope

options.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
options.description: Crowbar, hammer, pitons, torches, tinderbox, rations, waterskin, rope

options.name: Explorer's Pack
options.description: Bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin, rope

features.name: Hit Points
features.description: Hit Dice: 1d10 per Fighter level. HP at 1st level: 10 + Constitution modifier. HP at higher levels: 1d10 (or 6) + Constitution modifier per level above 1st.

features.name: Proficiencies
features.description: Armor: All armor, Shields. Weapons: Simple, Martial. Saving Throws: Strength, Constitution.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose 2 skills from the Fighter list.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following: Archery: +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons. Defense: +1 to AC while wearing armor. Dueling: +2 to damage rolls when wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons. Great Weapon Fighting: Reroll 1s or 2s on damage dice with two-handed/versatile weapons (must keep new roll). Protection: Use reaction to impose disadvantage on attack against nearby ally when wielding a shield. Two-Weapon Fighting: Add ability modifier to off-hand attack damage. Blind Fighting (TCoE): Blindsight 10ft. Interception (TCoE): Reaction to reduce damage to nearby ally by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Superior Technique (TCoE): Learn one Battle Master maneuver, gain 1 superiority die (d6). Thrown Weapon Fighting (TCoE): +2 to ranged attack/damage with thrown weapons; draw as part of attack. Unarmed Fighting (TCoE): Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 (1d8 if both hands free); grappled creatures take 1d4 bludgeoning at start of their turn.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.
features.note: Regain 1d10 + Fighter level HP

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.
features.note: Take one additional action this turn

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.description: At 3rd level, you choose an archetype that you strive to emulate in your combat styles and techniques.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level.
features.note: Attack twice instead of once when you take the Attack action

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack (2)
features.description: You can attack three times when you take the Attack action.
features.note: Attack three times when you take the Attack action

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Indomitable (2 uses)
features.description: At 13th level, you can use Indomitable twice between long rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Indomitable (3 uses)
features.description: At 17th level, you can use Indomitable three times between long rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Extra Attack (3)
features.description: You can attack four times when you take the Attack action.
features.note: Attack four times when you take the Attack action

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn maneuvers that are fueled by special dice called superiority dice (d8s). You have 4, gaining more as you level up.

features.name: Maneuvers
features.description: You learn 3 maneuvers of your choice. You learn 2 additional maneuvers at 7th, 10th, and 15th level.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: Starting at 7th level, if you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Starting at 15th level, when you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain one superiority die.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast spells. You learn 2 cantrips from the wizard spell list and 3 first-level spells from the abjuration or evocation schools.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: At 10th level, you learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's resistance to your spells. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: At 15th level, you gain the ability to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use your Action Surge.

Arcane Archer.name: Arcane Archer
Arcane Archer.description: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature — typical for practitioners of this elven martial tradition. You choose to gain proficiency in either the Arcana or the Nature skill, and you choose to learn either the prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.description: You learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. Choose 2 Arcane Shot options. You gain one more at levels 7, 10, 15, and 18. Each option can be used once per short or long rest (2 uses, increasing to 3 at level 15): Banishing Arrow: Charisma save or banished to Feywild for 1 round. Beguiling Arrow: Wisdom save or charmed. Bursting Arrow: 2d6 force damage to all within 10ft. Enfeebling Arrow: Constitution save or deal half damage for 1 min. Grasping Arrow: Grasping vines, 2d6 poison, speed -10ft. Piercing Arrow: Passes through objects, hits all in line, 1d6 piercing. Seeking Arrow: Doesn't miss, ignores cover, reveals location. Shadow Arrow: Wisdom save or can't see past 5ft.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.description: At 7th level, you gain the ability to infuse arrows with magic whenever you use your Attack action. Your arrows count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.description: At 7th level, you learn how to direct an errant arrow toward a new target. When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow and miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack roll against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.description: Starting at 15th level, your magical archery is available whenever battle starts. If you roll initiative and have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use of it.

Cavalier.name: Cavalier
Cavalier.description: The archetypal Cavalier excels at mounted combat. Usually born among the nobility and raised at court, a Cavalier is equally at home leading a cavalry charge or exchanging repartee at a state dinner.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, your mastery as a rider becomes apparent. You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount and descend no more than 10 feet, you can land on your feet if you're not incapacitated. Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can menace your foes, foiling their attacks and punishing them for harming others. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends early if you are incapacitated or you die, or if someone else marks the creature. While a creature is marked by you, it has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target you. In addition, if a creature marked by you deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special melee weapon attack against the marked creature as a bonus action on your next turn.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.description: At 7th level, you learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can roll 1d8 as a reaction if you're wielding a melee weapon or a shield. On a roll of 4 or higher, the triggering attack misses instead.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: At 10th level, you become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, and if you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you can run down your foes, whether you're mounted or not. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and you hit it with the attack, that target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.description: Starting at 18th level, you respond to danger with extraordinary vigilance. In combat, you get a special reaction that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. You can use this special reaction only to make an opportunity attack, and you can't use it on the same turn that you take your normal reaction.

Samurai.name: Samurai
Samurai.description: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies. A Samurai's resolve is nearly unbreakable, and the will to fight burns strong even when the samurai is severely weakened.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, your intensity in battle can shield you and help you attack. As a bonus action on your turn, you can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn. When you do so, you also gain 5 temporary hit points. The number of temporary hit points increases when you reach certain levels: 10 at 10th level and 15 at 15th level.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Starting at 7th level, your discipline and attention to detail allow you to excel in social situations. Whenever you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier. Your self-control also causes you to gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: Starting at 10th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you learn to trade accuracy for swift strikes. If you take the Attack action on your turn and have advantage on an attack roll against one of the targets, you can forgo the advantage for that roll to make an additional weapon attack against that target, as part of the same action. You can do so no more than once per turn.

features.name: Strength Before Death
features.description: Starting at 18th level, your fighting spirit can delay the grasp of death. If you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points and doesn't kill you outright, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious, and you can immediately take an extra turn, interrupting the current turn. While you have 0 hit points during that extra turn, taking damage causes death saving throw failures as normal, and three death saving throw failures can still kill you. When the extra turn ends, you fall unconscious if you still have 0 hit points.

Psi Warrior.name: Psi Warrior
Psi Warrior.description: Awoken to the psionic power within, a Psi Warrior is a fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. It is represented by your Psionic Energy dice, which are d6s. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You can use Psionic Energy dice in the following ways: Protective Field (reaction, spend one die to reduce damage to yourself or ally by amount rolled + Int mod), Psionic Strike (after hitting, spend one die to deal extra force damage equal to die roll + Int mod), Telekinetic Movement (move one Large or smaller creature or object up to 30ft as bonus action). Regain one die on short rest, all on long rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: By 7th level, you have mastered new ways to use your telekinetic abilities: Psi-Powered Leap (bonus action to give yourself flying speed equal to twice your walking speed until end of current turn), Telekinetic Thrust (when you deal damage with Psionic Strike, target must make Strength saving throw DC 8 + proficiency + Int mod or be knocked prone or moved up to 10ft).

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: Starting at 10th level, the psionic power flowing through you has bolstered your mind. You have resistance to psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn charmed or frightened, you can spend one Psionic Energy die and end every effect on yourself causing you to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you can shield yourself and others with telekinetic force. As a bonus action, you can choose creatures, which can include you, that you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures is protected by half cover for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, your ability to move creatures and objects with your mind is matched by few. You can cast the telekinesis spell, requiring no components, and your spellcasting ability for the spell is Intelligence. On each of your turns while you concentrate on the spell, including the turn you cast it, you can make one attack with a weapon as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Rune Knight.name: Rune Knight
Rune Knight.description: Rune Knights enhance their martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes, an ancient practice that originated with giants.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you choose this subclass at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with smith's tools, and you learn to speak, read, and write Giant.

features.name: Rune Carving
features.description: Also at 3rd level, you can use magic runes to enhance your gear.
