features.description: With 1 hour of work and expending 10 gp of materials, you can produce any artisan's tool, provided you have thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand. The tool appears fully assembled and functional. This action takes 1 hour.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Arcane Armament
features.description: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn, but one of the attacks must be made with a magic weapon. This replaces the Extra Attack feature for Artificers.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: At 6th level, your proficiency bonus is now doubled for any ability check you make that uses your proficiency with a tool.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: At 7th level, you've gained the ability to come up with solutions under pressure. When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: When you reach 10th level, you achieve a profound understanding of how to use and make magic items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once. If you craft a magic item with a rarity of common or uncommon, it takes you a quarter of the normal time, and it costs you half as much of the usual gold.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: At 11th level, you can now store a spell in an object. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one simple or martial weapon or one item that you can use as a spellcasting focus, and you store a spell in it, choosing a 1st- or 2nd-level spell from the artificer spell list that requires 1 action to cast. While holding the object, a creature can take an action to produce the spell's effect from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Savant
features.description: At 14th level, your skill with magic items deepens: You can attune to up to five magic items at once. You ignore all class, race, spell, and level requirements on attuning to or using a magic item.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can attune to up to six magic items at once.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. You cannot exceed 20 with this feature.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: At 20th level, you develop a mystical connection to your magic items, which you can draw on for protection: You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws per magic item you are currently attuned to. If you're reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can use your reaction to end one of your artificer infusions, causing you to drop to 1 hit point instead.

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.description: An Alchemist is an expert at combining reagents to produce mystical effects. Alchemists use their creations to give life and to leech it away.

features.name: Alchemist Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Alchemist's supplies. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Alchemist Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class: 3rd — Healing Word, Ray of Sickness; 5th — Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow; 9th — Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word; 13th — Blight, Death Ward; 17th — Cloudkill, Raise Dead.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: Beginning at 3rd level, whenever you finish a long rest, you can magically produce an experimental elixir in an empty flask you touch. Roll on the Experimental Elixir table for the elixir's effect. A creature can drink the elixir or administer it to an incapacitated creature as an action. The elixir lasts 24 hours. You can create additional elixirs by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher for each one. You can create a number of elixirs equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) for free each long rest.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: At 5th level, you've developed masterful command of magical chemicals, enhancing the healing and damage you create through them. Whenever you cast a spell using your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, you gain a bonus to one roll of the spell: healing spells gain +Int modifier to one die of healing; spells that deal acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage gain +Int modifier to one damage roll.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you can incorporate restorative reagents into some of your works: Whenever a creature drinks an experimental elixir you created, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Intelligence modifier. You can cast Lesser Restoration without expending a spell slot, and it counts as an artificer spell for you. You can use this a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a long rest.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: By 15th level, you have been exposed to so many chemicals that they pose little risk to you, and you can use them to quickly end certain ailments: You gain resistance to acid and poison damage, and immunity to the poisoned condition. You can cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending a spell slot, without preparing them, and without material components, provided you use alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus. Once you cast either spell with this feature, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest.

Armorer.name: Armorer
Armorer.description: An Armorer infuses their armor with elemental energy and turns it into a weapon. Armorers walk into the thick of combat, shielded by their extraordinary inventions.

features.name: Armorer Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Armorer Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Magic Missile, Thunderwave; 5th — Mirror Image, Shatter; 9th — Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt; 13th — Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility; 17th — Passwall, Wall of Force.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Your metallurgical pursuits have led to you making armor a conduit for your magic. As an action, you can turn a suit of armor you are wearing into Arcane Armor, provided you have smith's tools in hand. You gain the following benefits: The armor can't be removed against your will. The armor attaches to you and expands to cover your entire body. The armor replaces any missing limbs. If the armor normally has a Strength requirement, the Arcane Armor lacks this requirement for you. You can use the armor as a spellcasting focus. The armor attaches and detaches as a bonus action.

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: Choose your Armor Model at 3rd level. Guardian: Thunder Gauntlets (1d8 thunder, target has disadvantage on attacks against others) and Defensive Field (bonus action: gain temp HP equal to artificer level, prof bonus uses/long rest). Infiltrator: Lightning Launcher (ranged 1d6 lightning, 90ft, one hit/turn adds 1d6 lightning), Powered Steps (+5ft speed), Dampening Field (advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Armor Modifications
features.description: At 9th level, you learn how to use your Infuse Item feature to specially modify your Arcane Armor. That armor now counts as separate items for the purposes of your Infuse Item feature: chest, boots, helmet, and the armor's special weapon. Each of those items can bear one of your infusions, and the infusions transfer over if you change your armor model with the Armor Model feature.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: At 15th level, your Arcane Armor gains additional benefits based on its model: Guardian — Deflect Attack (use reaction when a creature you can see hits a target within 30ft; the target gets +5 AC, potentially causing the attack to miss). Infiltrator — Improved Lightning Launcher (the 1d6 bonus lightning damage applies to all hits, not just one per turn, and the launcher deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage).

Artillerist.name: Artillerist
Artillerist.description: An Artillerist specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield. This destructive power is valued by armies in the wars on many different worlds.

features.name: Artillerist Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Woodcarver's tools. If you already have this proficiency (from your level 1 tool choice), you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Artillerist Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Shield, Thunderwave; 5th — Scorching Ray, Shatter; 9th — Fireball, Wind Wall; 13th — Ice Storm, Wall of Fire; 17th — Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description:
As an action, you can conjure a magical cannon in an unoccupied space on a horizontal surface within 5 feet of you. The cannon is a magical object. It occupies its space and has AC 18, HP equal to 5 × your artificer level, and immunity to poison damage and the poisoned condition. It disappears if reduced to 0 hp, if you conjure another cannon, or after 1 hour. As a bonus action, you can command the cannon to activate (it has a +7 to hit; uses your spell save DC). Choose its type when you create it:
• Flamethrower: 15-ft cone, 2d8 fire damage (Dex save half)
• Force Ballista: Ranged spell attack, 2d8 force damage, pushes 5ft
• Protector: Grants 1d8 + Int mod temp HP to all creatures within 10ft
At 15th level you can create two cannons per use.

bonusActions.name: Activate Flamethrower
bonusActions.description: The cannon breathes fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d8 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Activate Force Ballista
bonusActions.description: Make a ranged spell attack, originating from the cannon, at one creature or object within 120 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 force damage, and if the target is a creature, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the cannon.

bonusActions.name: Activate Protector
bonusActions.description: The cannon emits a burst of positive energy that grants itself and each creature of your choice within 10 feet of it a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point).

summon.name: Eldritch Cannon
summon.notes: Immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition. Disappears at 0 HP, after 1 hour, or when you conjure another.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: After you finish a long rest, you can use woodcarver's tools to make a wand, staff, or rod and inscribe a special sigil into it. This object becomes your arcane firearm. When you cast an artificer spell through the firearm, you can add +1d8 to one of the spell's damage rolls. You can inscribe a new firearm each long rest; the old one loses its power.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Starting at 9th level, every eldritch cannon you create is more destructive: The cannon's damage rolls all increase by 1d8. As an action, you can command the cannon to detonate if you are within 60 feet of it. Doing so destroys the cannon and forces each creature within 20 feet of it to make a DC saving throw (8 + prof + Int), taking 3d8 force damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: At 15th level, you're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using Eldritch Cannon: You and your allies have half cover while within 10 feet of a cannon you create with Eldritch Cannon, taking advantage of the cannon's magic. You can now have two cannons at the same time.

Battle Smith.name: Battle Smith
Battle Smith.description: Armies require a good supply of weapons and armor, and someone has to fill that need. Artificers of the Battle Smith subclass defend others and target foes from a distance using the magic-infused weapon of their own creation.

features.name: Battle Smith Tool Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with Smith's tools. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency with one other type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Battle Smith Spells
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you always have certain spells prepared: 3rd — Heroism, Shield; 5th — Branding Smite, Warding Bond; 9th — Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage; 13th — Aura of Purity, Fire Shield; 17th — Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, your combat training and your experiments with magic have paid off in two ways: You gain proficiency with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: By 3rd level, your tinkering has borne you a faithful companion, a steel defender. It's friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. In combat, the defender shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it takes on its turn is the Dodge action, unless you take a bonus action on your turn to command it to take another action. If the mending spell is cast on it, it regains 2d6 hit points. It regains half its hit points when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: At 9th level, you've learned new ways to channel arcane energy to harm or heal. When either you hit a target with a magic weapon attack or your steel defender hits a target, you can channel magical energy through the strike to create one of the following effects: The target takes an extra 2d6 force damage. Choose one creature or object you can see within 30 feet of the target. Magical energy leaps from the target to the chosen creature or object, healing the chosen creature for 2d6 hit points. You can use this energy a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once), but you can do so no more than once on a turn. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: At 15th level, your Arcane Jolt and steel defender become more powerful: The extra damage and the healing of your Arcane Jolt both increase to 4d6. Your steel defender gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class. Whenever your steel defender uses its Deflect Attack, the attacker takes force damage equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier.

Acolyte.description: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods, acting as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Insight and Religion.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write two additional languages of your choice.

features.name: Shelter of the Faithful
features.description: As an acolyte, you command the respect of those who share your faith and can perform religious ceremonies of your deity. You and your companions can expect free healing and care at a temple of your faith, though you must provide material components for spells. Those who share your religion will support you at a modest lifestyle. You might have a residence at a specific temple where you have a home.

startingItems.name: Holy Symbol
startingItems.description: A holy symbol of your deity

Charlatan.description: You have always had a way with people. You know what makes them tick, you can tease out their hearts desires after a few minutes of conversation, and with a few leading questions you can read them like they were children's books.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Tool Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit and a forgery kit.

features.name: False Identity
features.description: You have created a second identity including documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises. You can also forge documents including official papers and personal letters, as long as you have seen an example of the kind of document or handwriting you are trying to copy.

startingItems.name: Con tools
startingItems.description: Ten stoppered bottles, set of weighted dice, deck of marked cards, or signet ring of an imaginary duke

Criminal.description: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law. You have spent a lot of time among other criminals and still have contacts within the criminal underworld.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Deception and Stealth.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Thieves Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with thieves tools.

features.name: Criminal Contact
features.description: You have a reliable and trustworthy contact who acts as your liaison to a network of other criminals. You know how to get messages to and from your contact, even over great distances, through messengers, corrupt caravan masters, and seedy sailors.

Entertainer.description: You thrive in front of an audience. You know how to entrance them, entertain them, and even inspire them. Your poetics can stir the hearts of those who hear you, awakening grief or joy, laughter or anger.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Acrobatics and Performance.

features.name: Musical Instrument
features.description: You gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

features.name: Disguise Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit.

features.name: By Popular Demand
features.description: You can always find a place to perform, usually in an inn or tavern but possibly with a circus, theatre, or noble's court. You receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard as long as you perform each night. Your performance makes you something of a local figure wherever you have performed.

startingItems.name: The favor of an admirer
startingItems.description: Love letter, lock of hair, or trinket

Folk Hero.description: You come from a humble social rank, but you are destined for so much more. Already the people of your home village regard you as their champion, and your destiny calls you to stand against the tyrants and monsters that threaten the common folk everywhere.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Animal Handling and Survival.

features.name: Artisans Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

features.name: Vehicles (Land)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (land).

features.name: Rustic Hospitality
features.description: Since you come from the ranks of the common folk, you fit in among them with ease. You can find a place to hide, rest, or recuperate among other commoners, unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them. They will shield you from the law or anyone else searching for you, though they will not risk their lives for you.

Hermit.description: You lived in seclusion either in a sheltered community such as a monastery, or entirely alone for a formative part of your life. In your time apart from the clamour of society, you found quiet, solitude, and perhaps some of the answers you were looking for.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Medicine and Religion.

features.name: Herbalism Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with an herbalism kit.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Discovery
features.description: The quiet seclusion of your extended hermitage gave you access to a unique and powerful discovery. The exact nature of this revelation is up to you and your DM, but it might be a great truth about the cosmos, the deities, the powerful beings of the outer planes, or the forces of nature. It might be a site that no one else has ever seen, or a fact long forgotten, or a relic of the past that could rewrite history.

startingItems.name: Scroll case with notes
startingItems.description: Notes from your studies or prayers

Noble.description: You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land, collects taxes, and wields significant political influence.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in History and Persuasion.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Position of Privilege
features.description: Thanks to your noble birth, people are inclined to think the best of you. You are welcome in high society, and people assume you have the right to be wherever you are. The common folk make every effort to accommodate you, and other people of high birth treat you as a member of the same social sphere. You can secure an audience with a local noble if you need to.

Outlander.description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilisation and the comforts of town and technology. You have witnessed the migration of herds larger than forests and survived weather more extreme than any city-dweller could comprehend.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Survival.

features.name: Musical Instrument
features.description: You gain proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

features.name: Language
features.description: You can speak, read, and write one additional language of your choice.

features.name: Wanderer
features.description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, you can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided that the land offers berries, small game, water, and so forth.

Sage.description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. You scoured manuscripts, studied under sages, and pored over anything you could get your hands on. Your efforts have paid off with a wealth of arcane knowledge.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: Choose any 2 skills to be proficient in.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write two additional languages of your choice.

features.name: Researcher
features.description: When you attempt to learn or recall a piece of lore, if you do not know that information, you often know where and from whom you can obtain it. Usually this comes from a library, scriptorium, university, or sage. Your DM might rule that the knowledge you seek is secreted away in an almost inaccessible place, or that it simply cannot be found. Unearthing the deepest secrets of the multiverse can require an adventure or even a whole campaign.

Sailor.description: You sailed on a seagoing vessel for years. In that time, you faced down mighty storms, monsters of the deep, and those who wanted to sink your craft to the bottomless depths.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Perception.

features.name: Navigators Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with navigator's tools.

features.name: Vehicles (Water)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (water).

features.name: Ships Passage
features.description: When you need to, you can secure free passage on a sailing ship for yourself and your adventuring companions. You might sail on the ship you served on, or another ship you have good relations with. In return for your free passage, you and your companions are expected to assist the crew during the voyage.

Soldier.description: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, and learned basic survival techniques, including how to stay alive on the battlefield.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Athletics and Intimidation.

features.name: Gaming Set
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice.

features.name: Vehicles (Land)
features.description: You gain proficiency with vehicles (land).

features.name: Military Rank
features.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organisation still recognise your authority and influence, and defer to you if they are of a lower rank. You can invoke your rank to exert influence over other soldiers and requisition simple equipment or horses for temporary use. You can usually gain access to friendly military encampments and fortresses where your rank is recognised.

startingItems.name: Trophy from fallen enemy
startingItems.description: Dagger, broken blade, or piece of a banner

startingItems.name: Deck of cards or set of dice

Urchin.description: You grew up on the streets alone, orphaned, and poor. You had no one to watch over you or to provide for you, so you learned to provide for yourself. You fought fiercely over food and kept a constant watch out for other desperate souls who might take what you had.

features.name: Skill Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and Stealth.

features.name: Disguise Kit
features.description: You gain proficiency with a disguise kit.

features.name: Thieves Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with thieves tools.

features.name: City Secrets
features.description: You know the secret patterns and flow to cities and can find passages through the urban sprawl that others would miss. When you are not in combat, you (and companions you lead) can travel between any two locations in the city twice as fast as your speed would normally allow.

City Watch.description: You have served the community where you grew up, standing as its first line of defense against crime.

features.name: Watcher's Eye
features.description: Your experience in enforcing the law, and dealing with lawbreakers, gives you a feel for local laws and criminals. You can easily find the local outpost of the watch or a similar organization, and you know which neighborhoods are known for crime.

Clan Crafter.description: The Stout Folk are well known for their artisanship and the worth they place on a skilled worker.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: One type of artisan's tools.

features.name: Respect of the Stout Folk
features.description: As well respected as clan crafters are among outsiders, no one esteems them quite so highly as dwarves do. You always have free room and board in any place where shield dwarves or gold dwarves dwell.

Cloistered Scholar.description: As a child, you were inquisitive when your playmates were possessive or raucous. You spent your formative years as an apprentice, studying in one of Faerûn's great institutes of learning.

features.name: Library Access
features.description: You have free use of whatever library you grew up studying in. Though others must make donations or favors to access such libraries, you have access as a matter of course. You also know the people of the library and can call in favors from archivists, scholars, and librarians.

Courtier.description: In your earlier years, you were trained in courtly ways and the diplomacy of noble society.

features.name: Court Functionary
features.description: Your knowledge of how bureaucracies function lets you gain access to the records and inner workings of any noble court or governmental palace. You know how to get messages to and from nobles, and can conduct personal meetings with them if needed.

Faction Agent.description: Many organizations active in the world aren't bound by geographical borders. You have sworn allegiance to one such faction.

features.name: Safe Haven
features.description: As a faction agent, you have access to a secret network of supporters and operatives who can provide assistance on your adventures. You know a set of secret signs and passwords you can use to identify such operatives, who can provide you with access to a hidden safe house, free room and board, or assistance finding information.

Far Traveler.description: Almost by definition, you come from somewhere far away — a distant land whose customs are unfamiliar to the locals.

features.name: All Eyes on You
features.description: Your accent, mannerisms, figures of speech, and perhaps even your appearance all mark you as foreign. Curious glances are directed your way wherever you go. Locals assume you are a rich curiosity, or perhaps a spy. This can open doors in high society and help you get information.

Haunted One.description: You are haunted by something so terrible that you dare not speak of it. You've tried to bury it and run away from it, to no avail. Whatever this thing is that haunts you, it can be used as a source of strength in dark times.

features.name: Heart of Darkness
features.description: Those who look into your eyes can see that you have faced unimaginable horror and witnessed the depths of evil. Though they might fear you, commoners will extend every courtesy and do their utmost to help you. Unless you have shown yourself to be a danger to them, even an enemy cleric might help you in a pinch, though perhaps not without extracting a price.

Inheritor.description: You are the heir to something of great value — not mere coin or wealth, but an object, information, or a title that has been entrusted to you by a parent, a mentor, a liege, or some other figure of authority.

features.name: Inheritance
features.description: Choose or randomly determine your inheritance from the Inheritance table. Work with your DM to figure out the details. The inheritance might be a family heirloom, a piece of information, or a title with associated benefits.

Knight of the Order.description: You belong to an order of knights who have sworn oaths to achieve a certain goal.

features.name: Knightly Regard
features.description: You receive shelter and succor from members of your knightly order and those who are sympathetic to its aims. If your order is a religious one, you can gain aid from temples and related religious communities of your faith.

Mercenary Veteran.description: As a sell-sword who fought battles for coin, you're well acquainted with risking life and limb for a chance at a share of treasure.

features.name: Mercenary Life
features.description: You know the mercenary life as only someone who has experienced it can. You are able to identify mercenary companies by their emblems, and you know a little about any such company, including the names of its commanders. You can find mercenary work between adventures.

Urban Bounty Hunter.description: Before you became an adventurer, your life was already full of conflict and excitement, because you made a living tracking down people for pay.

features.name: Ear to the Ground
features.description: You are in frequent contact with people in the segment of society that your chosen quarries move through. These people might not be trustworthy, but they can give you valuable information. Your DM will tell you what they know.

Uthgardt Tribe Member.description: Though you might have only recently arrived in civilized lands, you are no stranger to the values of cooperation and group effort when striving for supremacy.

features.name: Uthgardt Heritage
features.description: You have an excellent knowledge of not only your tribe's territory, but also the terrain and resources of the rest of the North. You are familiar enough with any wilderness area that you find twice as much food and water as you normally would when you forage there.

Waterdhavian Noble.description: You are a scion of one of the great noble families of Waterdeep, a cosmopolitan city at the heart of the Sword Coast.

features.name: Kept in Style
features.description: While you are in Waterdeep or elsewhere in the North, your name and signet are known to every noble and merchant of consequence. You are treated as a guest by your social peers and other nobility. Common folk make every effort to accommodate you, though they might also try to take advantage of your wealth.

Witchlight Hand.description: You have spent your life working for a travelling carnival — the Witchlight Carnival — which visits the Material Plane once every eight years.

features.name: Carnival Fixture
features.description: The Witchlight Carnival provides you with free, modest lodgings and food. In addition, you know how to put on a good show. When you make a Charisma check as part of a carnival performance, you can add your proficiency bonus to the check if you aren't already doing so.

spells.name: Absorb Elements
spells.description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. You have resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn. Also, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, a target's hit points increase by an additional 5 for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, window, or an area within range no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options: Aquatic Adaptation, Change Appearance, or Natural Weapons.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for the spell's duration.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast in range and speak a message of up to 25 words. The beast will travel to a target destination you designate.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.description: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can't animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.description: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which has normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet. The eye can look in every direction. As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. There is no limit to how far away from you the eye can move.

spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.description: You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Choose two points on the ground that you can see, one up to 10 feet away and the other up to 500 feet away.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.description: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting knock on the object suppresses arcane lock for 10 minutes. While affected by this spell, the object is more difficult to break or force open; the DC to break it or pick any locks on it increases by 10.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as spectral frost that covers you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage. +5 temp HP and cold damage per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 5 temp HP; 5 cold damage to melee attacker; +5 per slot

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter all creatures within 10 feet. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn. On a success it takes half damage.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.description: You and up to eight willing creatures project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane. You leave your physical bodies behind, unconscious. Your astral form can explore freely, and death in the astral form returns you to your body.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action within the next 30 minutes.

spells.name: Aura of Purity
spells.description: Purifying energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) can't become diseased, has resistance to poison damage, and has advantage on saving throws against effects that cause any of the following conditions: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned.

spells.name: Aura of Vitality
spells.description: Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. You can use a bonus action to cause one creature in the aura (including you) to regain 2d6 hit points.

combat.notes: Bonus action heal 2d6 to one creature in 30-ft aura each turn

spells.name: Bane
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
spells.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

spells.name: Banishing Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, your weapon crackles with force, and the attack deals an extra 5d10 force damage to the target. Additionally, if this attack reduces the target to 50 hit points or fewer, you banish it. If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target disappears, returning to its home plane.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another place of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

combat.notes: Target banished on fail; permanent if on different native plane
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 4th

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armour it is wearing.

combat.notes: AC can't be less than 16 regardless of armour

spells.name: Beast Sense
spells.description: You touch a willing beast. For the duration, you can use your action to see through the beast's eyes and hear what it hears, and continue to do so until you use your action to return to your normal senses.

spells.name: Bigby's Hand
spells.description: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand. Clenched Fist, Forceful Hand, Grasping Hand, Interposing Hand are the modes available.

spells.name: Blade Ward
spells.description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw. When you cast this spell using a slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

combat.notes: +1d4 to attack rolls and saves for up to 3 creatures; +1 target per slot

spells.name: Blight
spells.description: Necromantic energy washes over a creature. It must make a Constitution saving throw taking 8d8 necrotic on a fail or half on success. Plants have disadvantage on the save.

spells.name: Blindness/Deafness
spells.description: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane. At the start of your next turn, you return to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the space you vanished from.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and becomes sheathed in booming energy. If the target willingly moves before then, it takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends. At 5th level the initial hit deals +1d8 thunder; at 11th +2d8; at 17th +3d8.

combat.notes: Extra damage only if target moves voluntarily

spells.name: Branding Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike. The attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to the target, which becomes visible if it's invisible, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and can't become invisible until the spell ends. At Higher Levels: 1d6 additional damage per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 15-ft cone; half on save

spells.name: Call Lightning
spells.description: A storm cloud appears in the shape of a cylinder that is 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see within range directly above you. The spell fails if you can't see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear. When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud. A bolt of lightning flashes down to that point. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

combat.notes: Call bolt each round as bonus action; +1d10 per slot above 3rd

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.description: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw.

spells.name: Cause Fear
spells.description: You awaken the sense of mortality in one creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the spell ends. Each round the target can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.

combat.notes: Frightened condition
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 1st

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.description: You attempt to charm a creature you can see. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you harm it. One additional target per slot above 4th.

combat.notes: Charmed creature is friendly

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. +1 target per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: Charmed as friendly; +1 target per slot above 1st
combat.slotScale: +1 additional target per slot level above 1st

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d8 necrotic damage and the target can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. If undead, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Damage scales at higher levels.

combat.notes: can't regain HP until your next turn

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature you can see. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder for the damage type. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the creature takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type. +1d8 per slot above 1st.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.description: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.description: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you or in an obvious location. The sensor remains for the duration. You can use your action to switch between seeing or hearing through the sensor.

spells.name: Cloud of Daggers
spells.description: You fill the air with spinning daggers in a cube 5 feet on each side, centered on a point you choose. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the spell's area or starts its turn there.

combat.notes: Damages on entry or start of turn

spells.name: Cloudkill
spells.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous, yellow-green fog centered on a point you choose within range. The fog spreads around corners. It lasts for the duration or until strong wind disperses the fog, ending the spell. Its area is heavily obscured. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. At Higher Levels: 1d8 additional damage per slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Color Spray
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powder or sand colored red, yellow, and blue)
spells.description: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll 6d10; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect.

spells.name: Command
spells.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

combat.notes: One-word command: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt

spells.name: Commune with Nature
spells.description: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves or other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.description: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear. You also understand any written language you see, provided you touch the surface on which the words are written.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws. At Higher Levels: 1d8 additional damage per slot level above 5th.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.description: You summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: one beast of CR 2, two beasts of CR 1, four beasts of CR 1/2, or eight beasts of CR 1/4.

combat.notes: Summon beasts up to CR 2 (or multiple lower CR) for 1 hour

spells.name: Conjure Barrage
spells.description: You throw a nonmagical weapon or fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air to create a cone of identical weapons that shoot forward and then disappear. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.description: You summon a fey creature of challenge rating 6 or lower. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see. If you lose concentration, the creature remains if it is hostile to you.

spells.name: Conjure Volley
spells.description: You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition from a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical weapon into the air and choose a point within range. Hundreds of duplicates of the ammunition or weapon fall in a volley from above and then disappear. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

spells.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
spells.description: You summon fey creatures that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. Choose one of the following options for what appears: one fey creature of challenge rating 2 or lower, two fey creatures of challenge rating 1 or lower, four fey creatures of challenge rating 1/2 or lower, or eight fey creatures of challenge rating 1/4 or lower.

combat.notes: Summon fey creatures up to CR 2 (or multiple lower CR)

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.description: You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other mysterious entity from another plane. Contacting this extraplanar intelligence can strain or even break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, you take 6d6 psychic damage and are insane until you finish a long rest.

combat.notes: DC 15 Int save or 6d6 psychic and insanity until long rest

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.description: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

spells.name: Control Flames
spells.description: You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You affect it in one of several ways: instantaneously expand/extinguish it, double/halve its illumination radius, change its color, or cause it to flicker.

spells.name: Cordon of Arrows
spells.description: You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground within range and lay magic upon them to protect an area. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to strike it.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails.

combat.notes: Counters spells 3rd level and lower automatically

spells.name: Create Bonfire
spells.description: You create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature that enters the bonfire for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there must also make this save.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.description: You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses within range. Each corpse becomes a ghoul under your control.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of water if creating, or a few grains of sand if destroying)
spells.description: You either create or destroy water. Create Water: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Destroy Water: You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range.

spells.name: Creation
spells.description: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object of vegetable matter within range: soft goods, rope, wood, or something similar. You can also use this spell to create mineral objects such as stone, crystal, or metal. The object created must be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and the object must be of a form and material that you have seen before. The duration depends on the object's material.

spells.name: Crown of Madness
spells.description: One humanoid of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you. The charmed target must use its action to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself you choose. You must use your action each round to maintain control.

combat.notes: Forces melee attack on ally each round

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

combat.notes: + spellcasting modifier

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover in the air for the duration. You can also combine the four lights into one glowing vaguely humanoid form of Medium size. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the lights up to 60 feet.

combat.notes: Illuminates 10-ft radius dim light per orb

spells.name: Darkness
spells.description: Magical darkness spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for the duration. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through this magical darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

combat.notes: 15-ft radius magical darkness; blocks darkvision and nonmagical light

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

spells.name: Daylight
spells.description: A 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreads out from a point you choose within range. The sphere is bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. If you chose a point on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object with and moves with it.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.description: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends. If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.

combat.notes: Once: drop to 1 HP instead of 0; or negate instant-kill effect

spells.name: Decompose
spells.description: You reach out and touch a corpse. Over the next minute, the corpse begins to rapidly decompose, sprouting fungus and moss as it breaks down into compost.

spells.name: Demiplane
spells.description: You create a shadowy door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. The door leads to a demiplane that appears to be an empty room 30 feet in each dimension.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.description: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located. Similarly, you know if there is a place or object within 30 feet of you that has been magically consecrated or desecrated.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any. This spell can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

combat.notes: Sense magic within 30 ft; see school of magic

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you cast the spell and as your action on each turn, you can focus your mind on any creature within 30 feet. If the creature has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak a language, it is unaffected. You learn the surface thoughts of that creature.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: You teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction. You can bring along objects as long as their weight doesn't exceed what you can carry. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity.

combat.notes: Teleport self + one creature up to 500 ft

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.description: You make yourself — including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person — look different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: Choose any creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a successful check, the spell ends.

combat.notes: End spell of 3rd level or lower; ability check for higher

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature of your choice within range can hear, wracking it with terrible pain. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction, if available, to move as far as its speed allows away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have to move away. +1d6 per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: target must move away on fail

spells.name: Divination
spells.description: Your magic and an offering put you in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question about a specific goal, event, or activity within 7 days. The DM offers a truthful reply.

spells.name: Divine Favor
spells.description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

combat.notes: +1d4 radiant damage on weapon attacks for duration

spells.name: Dominate Beast
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. While charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as you are on the same plane.

combat.notes: Charmed beast obeys telepathic commands

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a creature you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. The charmed target obeys your commands to the best of its ability.

combat.notes: Full mental domination; telepathic commands

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.description: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence.

combat.notes: Charmed humanoid obeys telepathic commands

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: You touch one willing creature and imbue it with the power to spew magical energy from its mouth. Until the spell ends, the creature can use an action to exhale energy in a 15-foot cone dealing 3d6 damage of a chosen type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison).

spells.name: Dream
spells.description: You, or a willing creature you touch, enters a trance-like state and the target messenger visits a creature within range while it sleeps and delivers a short message. The messenger can shape the dreamscape and create nightmares.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range: a tiny, harmless sensory effect predicting the weather; cause a flower to bloom; create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect such as falling leaves or a puff of wind; or light or snuff a candle, torch, or small campfire.

combat.notes: Minor nature effects: weather prediction, cause flower to bloom, etc.

spells.name: Dust Devil
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dust)
spells.description: Choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within range. An elemental force that resembles a dust devil appears in the cube and lasts for the spell's duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet must make a Strength saving throw or take 1d8 bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Earth Tremor
spells.description: You cause a tremor in the ground in a 10-foot radius. Each creature other than you in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.

spells.name: Earthbind
spells.description: Choose one creature you can see within range. Yellow strips of magical energy loop around the creature. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or its flying speed (if any) is reduced to 0 feet for the spell's duration.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage. The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels: two beams at 5th level, three beams at 11th level, and four beams at 17th level. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

combat.notes: multiple beams at higher levels (2 at 5th, 3 at 11th, 4 at 17th)

spells.name: Elemental Bane
spells.description: Choose one creature you can see and one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell for its duration. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage. Additionally, the target loses any resistance to that damage type until the spell ends. At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.description: A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. For the duration, the weapon has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deals an extra 1d4 damage of the chosen type on a hit.

combat.slotScale: +1 attack at 5th, +2d4 at 5th; +2 attack at 7th, +3d4 at 7th

spells.name: Encode Thoughts
spells.description: You pull a memory, an idea, or a message from your mind and transform it into a tangible string of glowing energy called a thought strand. You or another creature can later cast the cantrip again to decode the strand's content.

spells.name: Enemies Abound
spells.description: You reach into the mind of one creature and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe and regards all creatures as enemies until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Target treats all creatures as enemies

spells.name: Enhance Ability
spells.description: You touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement. Choose one of the following effects; the target gains that effect until the spell ends. Bear's Endurance, Bull's Strength, Cat's Grace, Eagle's Splendor, Fox's Cunning, or Owl's Wisdom — each grants advantage on related ability checks and a bonus. At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powdered iron)
spells.description: You cause a creature or an object you can see within range to grow larger or smaller for the duration. Choose either a creature or a non-magical object. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell has no effect.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the magical vines until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Restrained by vines on failed save after next weapon hit

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained by the entangling plants until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Restrained in 20-ft square; difficult terrain for duration

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.description: You weave a distracting string of words causing creatures of your choice to make a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Perception checks until the spell ends.

combat.notes: Disadvantage on Perception checks

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.description: You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, in the area where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration or until you use your action to dismiss the spell.

spells.name: Evard's Black Tentacles
spells.description: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 bludgeoning damage and be restrained. A restrained creature takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.

combat.notes: Restrained on failed save; ongoing 3d6 each turn

spells.name: Expeditious Retreat
spells.description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.description: For the duration your eyes become an inky void. One creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of three effects of your choice: asleep, panicked, or sickened.

combat.notes: Choose: asleep, panicked (frightened+must flee), or sickened (disadvantage on attacks/checks)

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.description: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, or clothes from flax or wool. Choose raw materials that you can see within range. You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube, or eight connected 5-foot cubes), given a sufficient quantity of raw material. If you are working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. Any attack roll against an affected creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

combat.notes: Attackers have advantage against outlined targets; negates invisibility

spells.name: False Life
spells.description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you gain 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened.

combat.notes: Frightened; must use movement to flee

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)
spells.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. For the duration, the target appears dead and is blinded and incapacitated, has resistance to all damage except psychic, and is immune to poison.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.description: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.description: You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes anything that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8+30 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid killed by this spell rises as a zombie under your control.

combat.notes: +30 damage; killed humanoids rise as zombies

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire hurls toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. Damage increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th, and 4d10 at 17th.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.description: Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose. The warm shield grants you resistance to cold damage, and the chill shield grants you resistance to fire damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes 2d8 fire damage (warm) or cold damage (chill).

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 fire damage per slot above 3rd.

combat.notes: 20-ft radius; half on save

spells.name: Flame Blade
spells.description: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar, and it lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke the blade again as a bonus action.

spells.name: Flame Strike
spells.description: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. +1d6 fire and +1d6 radiant per slot above 5th.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. At Higher Levels: 1d6 additional damage per slot level above 2nd.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall. When you cast this spell using a slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

combat.notes: 60 ft fly speed; +1 target per slot above 3rd

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. +20 ft radius per slot above 1st.

combat.notes: 20-ft heavily obscured sphere; +20 ft radius per slot

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.description: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space within range. Creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals within the area. You can designate damage types.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.description: An immovable prison of force springs into existence around you. You create a cage or box of force. Creatures inside can't leave by nonmagical means.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against it.
